prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE newly rendered premium tactile metal game figurine on genuinely transparent RGBA background, 2:3 portrait full-body. Image1 is immutable original grade identity; image2 is the approved WR pilot material/light style. Preserve image1's distinctive wire-based structure, face inside open ring/cage, spiral emblem, grade-specific surface and components, in a slightly refreshed pose. Render polished and brushed metal with warm workshop light on subject and subtle cool rim. Wire coils/strands must remain evident; never turn into sheet-metal armor, vest or helmet humanoid. Keep full head/hands/feet and tool within canvas, character about 82% height with generous margins. No background, floor, shadow outside subject, pedestal, text, numbers, letters, logo, UI, card frame, watermark. Transparent gaps between wire. Welding-wire variant: copper/brass curved teardrop wire cage with curled copper top, suspended small smiling round brass face. Tapered rounded brass coil/wire body with pale horizontal band and spiral medallion. Bead-chain left arm; curved thin wire right arm ends in tiny welding nozzle holding amber molten droplet. Warm copper wire ends, intact small rounded feet. Preserve original distinctive teardrop and welding droplet; no giant flame.
